```{r}
library(wwntests)
```


```{r}
sim <- sim_FARMA(
            n = 1000,
            d = 0,
            no_grid = 101,
            seed_number = 2,
            p = 1,
            q = 1,
            ar_strength = 0.6,
            ma_strength = 0.6,
            lag_strength = "equal"
          )
X = sim$X
```



```{r}
l = floor(log(ncol(X)))

select_order_residual_test(X = X,
                                       Npc = 1,
                                       lag_test = l,
                                       alpha = 0.05,
                                       verbose = TRUE) 
```






```{r}
library(doMC)
library(foreach)


n_cores <- 10

registerDoMC(cores = n_cores)

seeds <- 1:50

results <- foreach(
  seed = seeds,
  .combine = rbind,
  .packages = c("wwntests")
) %dopar% {

  sim <- sim_FARMA(
    n = 5000,
    d = 0,
    no_grid = 101,
    seed_number = seed,
    p = 2,
    q = 1,
    ar_strength = 0.9,
    ma_strength = 0.9,
    lag_strength = "equal"
  )

  X <- sim$X
  l <- floor(log(ncol(X)))

  res <- select_order_residual_test(
    X = X,
    Npc = 1,
    lag_test = l,
    alpha = 0.05,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  if (is.null(res)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        seed = seed,
        p_hat = NA,
        q_hat = NA,
        p_value = NA
      )
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    seed = seed,
    p_hat = res$p,
    q_hat = res$q,
    p_value = res$p_value
  )
}
```
